$comment: Starter Kits the HarnessRouter console can launch. One folder per kit under kits/.
A kit is a whole product in a folder: the Harness it needs (base, skills, tools) and a UI
that talks to that Harness as its backend. Launching one provisions the Harness and opens
the app; there is no separate service to deploy and no database to configure.
include        — build this kit into the image. false leaves it in the repo and out of the
image, which is how a kit under development stays unshipped.
Everything else a kit needs lives in kits/<name>/kit.json, next to the code it describes,
so adding a kit does not mean editing this file beyond one line.
